title: Create Combined
body:
[![Create Combined Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5a98058b85429a9f2e8ae74cdf0ae6ca7d1c3de4.png)](https://discord.gg/Asv7EJSJf5) Create Combined is a Create-focused sandbox pack about building, exploring, and gradually turning a normal survival world into something much bigger. Create ties most of the pack together. You can build the usual factories and contraptions, but there is plenty of room to go further with custom trains, diesel engines, cannons, automated kitchens, and enchantment production. Aeronautics and Sable let you build vehicles, aircraft, airships, and other moving structures with real physics. There isn't a quest book deciding what you should do next. Just pick a project and see how far you can take it. The world has had just as much attention as the machinery. Continents creates larger landmasses and deeper oceans, while WWOO, Geophilic, and Stony Cliffs reshape and fill out the terrain. YUNG's overhauled structures, Luki's capitals and dungeons, AdoraBuild, and Create-themed ruins give you more to find along the way. The scale of the world also gives trains and aircraft an actual reason to exist beyond looking cool beside your base. ![A landscape changing over time](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/541b1c90b9f5be1be4c1c4b976386d334700ce43.png) There is still plenty to do when you aren't working on a factory. Naturalist adds new wildlife, while Farmer's Delight, Slice & Dice, and Tide expand farming, cooking, and fishing. Exposure adds working cameras and photographs, Etched lets you collect and play music, and the extra furniture, paintings, and building blocks help make your base feel lived in. I've also made some changes of my own to help everything fit together. Naturalist's fish and meats can be used with Farmer's Delight, crops work with diesel production, and a few missing recipes have been added. Some overlapping parts of Create: Propulsion were removed, and the strongest enchantments can't simply be printed forever. These are mostly small changes, but they make the pack feel more connected. Create Combined is a fairly large pack, so it includes Sodium, Lithium, ModernFix, C2ME, FerriteCore, and several other performance mods. Iris and Complementary Reimagined are included if you want shaders, along with improved weather, particles, lighting, and sound. ![Bisect Hosting Banner](https://www.bisecthosting.com/partners/custom-banners/2dc0ab1a-7149-4c52-98fa-5173d0127d95.webp) ## Community Videos If you make a video with the pack, let me know! I'd love to feature factory tours, showcases, playthroughs, or whatever else you come up with.
